:::{#def-mode}
#### Mode of a density or mass function

Let $X$ be a [random variable](#def-random-variable)
with [density](#def-pdf) or [mass function](#def-pmf) $f$.
The **modes** of $f$ are the elements of the [argmax](https://morrison-lab.github.io/mds/algebra.html#def-argmax) of $f$ over the [range](#def-range) of $X$:

$$\modef{f} = \argmax_{x \in \rangef{X}} f(x).$$

A **mode** of $f$ is an element of $\modef{f}$.

:::
